title: Scalar-adjunction projection agrees with tensor projection for arbitrary coefficients
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $d$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Write $R_T$ for its completed coefficient sheaf, $R_T^0$ for the limit of constant finite quotient sheaves, and $b_T:R_T^0\cong R_T$ for the canonical limit comparison [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Assume the canonical completed coefficient map $c_f:f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$ is invertible. Let $F^{\rm ab}$ be an additive ordinary functor with an equality identifying it with generic ringed direct image over $R_Y,R_X$ with coefficient isomorphism $\operatorname{asIso}(c_f)$, and put $F=R(F^{\rm ab})$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and $F^0,L^0$ direct image and pullback over $R^0$ with the canonical completed coefficient identification [lemma-weil-pbc-perfect-projection-formula]. Choose arbitrary commutative ring sheaves $S_Y,S_X$, maps $\varphi_T:R_T\to S_T$, and $c:f^{-1}S_Y\cong S_X$ such that $c_f;\varphi_X=f^{-1}(\varphi_Y);c$. Choose an additive ordinary functor $G^{\rm ab}$ equal to ringed direct image with coefficient isomorphism $c$, and put $G=R(G^{\rm ab})$ and let $E_T\dashv U_T$ be derived extension and exact restriction along $\varphi_T$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Suppose $i:U_X^{\rm ab};F^{\rm ab}\cong G^{\rm ab};U_Y^{\rm ab}$ is identity on underlying sections and $e:U_X;F\cong G;U_Y$ is its derived comparison, normalized by the universal right-derived units on every cochain complex $C$: $u_F(U_X C);F(\rho_X^{-1}(C));e_{QC}=Q(i_C);\rho_Y^{-1}(G^\bullet C);U_Y(u_G(C))$. Here $\rho_T$ is the canonical localization comparison for exact restriction and $u_F,u_G$ are the universal derived units. No finiteness, flatness or perfectness of $S_T$ over $R_T$ is assumed.

Let $P\in D(R_Y^0)$ and fix $r:(\operatorname{Res}_{b_Y;\varphi_Y}S_Y)[0]\cong P$. For every $K\in D(R_X)$ set $K^0=\operatorname{Res}_{b_X}K$. There are tensor models $a_Y,a_X$ presenting ordinary uncompleted derived tensor by signed total tensor on flat K-flat representatives, and isomorphisms $s:\operatorname{Res}_{b_Y}U_YE_YF(K)\cong a_Y(F^0K^0,P)$ and $t:\operatorname{Res}_{b_Y}U_YGE_X(K)\cong F^0(a_X(K^0,L^0P))$, such that $\operatorname{Res}_{b_Y}(U_Y(\pi_{\rm scalar}(K)));t=s;\pi_{\rm tensor}(K^0,P)$. Here $\pi_{\rm scalar}$ is the $E_Y\dashv U_Y$ transpose of $F(\eta_X(K));e_{E_XK}$, and $\pi_{\rm tensor}$ is the canonical tensor-pullback/counit projection morphism [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-map]. The conclusion identifies these specified morphisms and asserts no invertibility of either projection.

proof.text: Construct ordinary uncompleted tensor models using the native localization tensor and its flat K-flat representative isomorphism. No arbitrary witness from an existence theorem is selected.

Transport the normalized scalar mate to literal inverse-image ring coefficients. This uses only scalar and geometric adjunctions, including the section normalization of i and derived-unit normalization of e.

Apply the existing arbitrary ring-sheaf scalar-mate normalization to chi=bY;phiY and the transported K. Cancel its source comparison to identify restricted beta followed by its tensor target comparison with its tensor source comparison followed by the specified projection.

Transport this tensor projection through the canonical completed coefficient isomorphism and r. Compose source and target isomorphisms. Associativity, the two transport squares, and hom-inverse cancellation give exactly the original displayed equality.

lean.statement:
theorem completedScalarProjectionTensorComparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) [IsIso (completedCoefficientMap f d)]
    (SY : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (SX : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (φY : pbcAdicCompletion Y d ⟶ SY) (φX : pbcAdicCompletion X d ⟶ SX)
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj SY ≅ SX)
    (hc : completedCoefficientMap f d ≫ φX =
      (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map φY ≫ c.hom)
    (F : pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d) ⥤ pbcModules Y (pbcAdicCompletion Y d))
    [F.Additive]
    (hF : F = proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f (pbcAdicCompletion Y d)
      (pbcAdicCompletion X d) (asIso (completedCoefficientMap f d)))
    (G : pbcModules X SX ⥤ pbcModules Y SY) [G.Additive]
    (hG : G = proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f SY SX c)
    (i : pbcRestrict φX ⋙ F ≅
      G ⋙ pbcRestrict φY)
    (hi : ∀ (M : pbcModules X SX) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ),
      HEq (fun x ↦ (i.hom.app M).val.app U x)
        (fun x : ((proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f SY SX c).obj M).val.obj U ↦ x))
    (e : pbcDerivedRestrict φX ⋙ F.rightDerivedFunctor ≅
      G.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ pbcDerivedRestrict φY)
    (he : ∀ C : CochainComplex (pbcModules X SX) ℤ,
      F.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ
          (((pbcRestrict φX).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
        F.rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((pbcRestrict φX).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app C) ≫
        e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex i.hom (.up ℤ)).app C) ≫
        (pbcRestrict φY).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
          ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
        (pbcDerivedRestrict φY).map (G.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ C))
    (P : PerfectProjection.derived d Y)
    (r : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (PerfectProjection.modules d Y) 0).obj
        ((pbcRestrict ((pbcCompletedComparison Y d).hom ≫ φY)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (reductionModuleRing Y SY))) ≅ P)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d))) :
    ∃ (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y (PerfectProjection.ring d Y))
      (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X (PerfectProjection.ring d X))
      (s : (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison Y d).hom).obj
          ((pbcDerivedRestrict φY).obj
            ((pbcDerivedExtend φY).obj
              (F.rightDerivedFunctor.obj K))) ≅
        aY.tensor.obj
          ((PerfectProjection.directImage d f).obj
            ((pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison X d).hom).obj K), P))
      (t : (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison Y d).hom).obj
          ((pbcDerivedRestrict φY).obj
            (G.rightDerivedFunctor.obj
              ((pbcDerivedExtend φX).obj K))) ≅
        (PerfectProjection.directImage d f).obj
          (aX.tensor.obj
            ((pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison X d).hom).obj K,
              (PerfectProjection.pullback d f).obj P))),
      (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison Y d).hom).map
          ((pbcDerivedRestrict φY).map
            (((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φY).homEquiv _ _).symm
              (F.rightDerivedFunctor.map
                  ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φX).unit.app K) ≫
                e.hom.app ((pbcDerivedExtend φX).obj K)))) ≫ t.hom =
        s.hom ≫ PerfectProjection.projection d f aY aX
          ((pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison X d).hom).obj K) P
